summary: Changed GLM-5.3 qkvbfg fusion eligibility from a global quant_config check to per-projection quant-method resolution, while preserving the attention-TP constraint and keeping the synthetic fused projection unquantized.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the exact base gate: all six GLM-5.3 attention prefixes resolved to UnquantizedLinearMethod, but the global quant_config check still returned false and disabled fusion.

Passing-after fusion decision for FP8 experts with unquantized attention, rejection of partially quantized projections, preservation of the TP-layout guard, and existing prefix-matching boundaries; 7 tests passed.
Actual BF16 fused linear primitives on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 versus independent torch.nn.functional.linear and torch.bmm references; maximum absolute error 0.0 for both stages.
Repository formatting, lint, static file checks, and registered-test metadata checks for changed files.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-645d11addaa7/raw/gfx950-fused-linear-numerical.txt records execution on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with exact agreement to PyTorch references.

remaining_limitations: The official GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so full-model serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported TP8 deployment and multi-GPU performance were not reproduced.
The GPU fixture validates the fused linear primitives and shapes, not the complete model architecture or end-to-end generation.
